messages.subject: Mathjax
parts:
More a generic question re: Rstudio:

I note that Rstudio creates a mathjax-23 directory and it is apparent that this is the version used to render math in R-presentations and conversions to HTML.

However, there is a well-documented problem when viewing using latest Chrome browser - namely, the math displays with a vertical bar at the end.

Apparently the fix is to use mathjax-26, but try as I may, I can't see how to get Rstudio to use mathjax 2.6.

Any suggestions??
